title: US Electric Power Transmission Lines
derived_features: line proximity, voltage and owner diversity
limitations: Approximate line geometry; no substation, spare capacity or interconnection availability.

title: National Hydrography Dataset flowlines
limitations: Small-scale surface hydrography; not water rights, quality, intake capacity or utility service.

title: Major Roads
limitations: Geometric access proxy; not travel time, congestion or site entrance suitability.

title: IPEDS HD and Completions
derived_features: institutions and CIP 11/14 completions within 50/100 km
limitations: Awards are education-output proxies, not available workers, skills, migration or wage cost.

title: County Business Patterns
derived_features: county total, information and professional/scientific employment
limitations: County resolution; workplace employment. Absent county-sector rows are encoded as zero with flag NO_PUBLISHED_ROW; published noise flags are preserved.

title: Census Geocoder
derived_features: address coordinates for TNCAND-005 and TNCAND-017
limitations: TIGER address-range interpolation; not a parcel centroid or surveyed facility point.

title: TIGERweb Tennessee Incorporated Places
limitations: Market-level representative point because the project parcel is not public; not a site coordinate.
